value.rationale: Gamma/Erlang maturation represents physically motivated multistage activation uncertainty at fixed mean. The theorem provides a global one-peak classification and strict dependence on latency variability and discovers a singular high-frequency difference: linear frequency growth of the optimum and shape-dependent power attenuation versus bounded deterministic optimum. This gives falsifiable response-level design predictions beyond routine algebraic substitution without asserting a microscopic universal law.
